notes.title: ViewTracker 1.01 Update Released
notes.notes:
ViewTracker 1.01 is out with several fixes and some new features:

- Fixed problem restarting app after a crash
- Stability improvements
- Fixed issue where some webcams would run at less than 30 fps
- Minor performance improvements
- Support for Prepar3d v4 via SimConnect
- vjoystick support (requires installing vjoystick driver)
- Option to hide green box around face in video preview

Thank you to everyone who has tried out ViewTracker so far! Please feel free to let me know how it's working or any changes you would like to see.
